name: Army-Navy Basic Finner reference projectile (model of the DREV aeroballistic range tests)
primary_source: Dupuis & Hathaway, DREV-TM-9703 (1997): Sec. 3.1 (PDF p. 16), Fig. 2 (PDF p. 53), Table I (PDF p. 36), Table II (PDF p. 37)
pdf_pages: page numbers of the DTIC scan ADA636861 (153 pages), see sources.md

reference.moment_reference_source: Sec. 5.2 (PDF p. 22): 'at 55 % of the length from the nose of the projectile (5.50 cal)'; Table I CG 16.50 cm; Table II CG 5.485-5.541 cal per model

nose.tip: meplat of radius 0.004 cal (text Sec. 3.1: 'The meplat of the nose was also at a radius of a 0.004 cal'; Fig. 2 marks the tip 'R 0.004')

body.base: flat, square edge; the fin trailing edges are flush with the base (Fig. 2)

fins.arrangement: cruciform; nominal cant 0, 2 and 4 deg on different models (Table III), all four fins of a model at the same cant
fins.section: single wedge ('conical in shape'): thickness 0.08 cal at the base of the fin (blunt trailing edge), sharp leading edge of radius 0.004 cal (Sec. 3.1, Fig. 2)

test_conditions.facility: DREV Aeroballistic Range (free flight, spark shadowgraph stations, 6DOF maximum likelihood reduction with BARDAS)
test_conditions.mach_range: 1.05-4.47 (mid-range Mach of each shot, Table VII)
test_conditions.reynolds_length: 7.0e6-30.0e6 (based on the projectile length, Table V)
test_conditions.transition_and_roughness: not stated (steel models; shadowgraphs show the boundary-layer growth, Sec. 3.3)
test_conditions.spin: 0, about 65 and about 125 deg/m steady spin for 0, 2 and 4 deg cant (Sec. 8.0)
test_conditions.note: fins of shot DA14 (about 1520 m/s) ablated, no data; slight ablation suspected on DA01 and DA11 (Sec. 5.2)

model_in_this_repository.units: STEP declares millimetres; STL in millimetres; x from the nose tip (x = 0) to the base (x = 0.300 m), the nose points to -x
model_in_this_repository.fins: the '+' arrangement (fins in the planes y = 0 and z = 0), no cant
model_in_this_repository.nose: flat meplat of radius 0.12 mm at x = 0, cone to (85.2 mm, 15 mm): half angle atan(14.88 / 85.2) = 9.907 deg (the drawing's 10 deg, 2.84 cal and the 0.004 cal meplat are not exactly consistent; the difference is below 0.01 cal in radius)
model_in_this_repository.fin_section: wedge with a leading-edge arc of radius 0.12 mm tangent to both faces, front of the arc at x = 270 mm, faces through the trailing-edge corners (x = 300 mm, +-1.2 mm); flat fin tip at r = 45 mm
